description: Are any of these crypto addresses on OFAC’s SDN sanctions list? Up to 100 addresses screened in one call, checked by Distill against OFAC’s own SDN file. The same answer as sanctions.address for each address, in order, from one SDN publication. An address that is not one (spaces, too long) carries its own error; the call is still one price. No address is stored. Updated daily. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the list is OFAC’s, matched exactly): 1 until 3 days after the last check of OFAC’s Sanctions List Service, then halving every 3 days. Facts from the OFAC SDN list as published on the date stated: an exact match of the address as given (EVM and Bech32 addresses case-insensitively). Not legal advice and not a compliance determination: no ownership (50% rule) analysis, no indirect exposure, no other sanctions list. Computed by Distill from OFAC’s SDN.XML. See /terms.
